scope: Arithmetic and stored-log provenance only. Missing syllable is reported by Gemini; Codex has not independently listened.

animation_spec.typography: House large bold sans-serif, <= 4 words per line, 11.5% of 16:9 centre band height, over moving graded plate (no black slab)

s5_overlay.selection_rationale: Chief J1016 ruling: keep the single card on the model-distance line only with '1-CM SCALE' / 'OVER 100 METERS', starting at the recorded '100' at 16.180s and ending at 'pitch.' by 19.160s (2.980s <= 4.000s). '1/5 LIGHT-YEAR' is removed from the card because 'fifth' (20.080s) and 'light-year.' (20.560-21.140s) are spoken after the card ends; the spoken final sentence ('That is about a fifth of a light-year.') supplies the real-distance distinction with no second overlay.

verifier_scope_findings: earliest_spoken_answer is a supplied word index; verifier checks its coordinates, not semantic earliest-answer choice.
Source-window decode and OCR are read from a saved log, not rerun by verify_j0936_prep_v04.py.
2fps OCR/contact sheets are samples for textual content; 30fps luma/scdet does not inspect every frame for text.
Multimodal reviewer statements and numeric subject occupancy are supplied assertions, not computed by the verifier.
